openActions.title: Define a release readiness checklist with automated pre-deploy gates
openActions.description: The team raised release reliability themes (FB-0001, FB-0002). A shared go/no-go checklist and automated pipeline gates should catch blockers before promote.
openActions.teams: Dev Team, QA Team, Ops Team

openActions.title: Agree an urgent PR first-response SLA and escalation path
openActions.description: Slow turnaround on urgent reviews was raised (FB-0003, FB-0005). Set a measurable first-response target and escalation when reviewers are unavailable.

openActions.title: Pilot two-reviewer policy exceptions for labeled hotfix PRs
openActions.description: Urgent review delays and two-reviewer policy appeared together (FB-0003, FB-0005). Pilot hotfix-labeled exceptions with mandatory post-merge review.

openActions.title: Timebox planning sessions and require async pre-reads plus decision logs
openActions.description: Long planning and async status ideas (FB-0004, FB-0006). Cap live planning and distribute pre-reads before the session.

reportExcerpt.themesSummary: Release reliability and incident response: The team reported dependable production releases with no rollbacks and coordinated quickly when a customer escalation arrived. Code review turnaround: Review turnaround remains a bottleneck for urgent fixes; the team wants consistent two-reviewer practice from earlier retros. Sprint planning efficiency: Planning sessions exceed ninety minutes; the team proposed time-boxing and async status notes.

topicBreakdown.label: Deployment reliability
topicBreakdown.summary: The team reported dependable production releases with no rollbacks and coordinated quickly when a customer escalation arrived.

topicBreakdown.label: Code review delays
topicBreakdown.summary: Review turnaround remains a bottleneck for urgent fixes; the team wants consistent two-reviewer practice carried forward from earlier retrospectives.

topicBreakdown.label: Long meetings / planning
topicBreakdown.summary: Sprint planning sessions routinely exceed ninety minutes; the team proposed time-boxing live planning and replacing status updates with async notes.
